composition.value: Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies.
composition.note: The composer died in 1943. This is a term calculation, not a worldwide clearance or a statement about an unidentified modern edition.

recording.value: Rule 3 — territorial: sound recording public domain in the European Union (pre-1963 publication basis).
recording.note: Commons applies PD-EU-audio to Richter/Wisłocki’s DG recording attributed to 1959; the dossier preserves the 26–28 April session range. Usable under the programme’s pre-1963 European sound-recording rule; the former 50-year term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is territorial, not a worldwide licence; US sound-recording status is not established. A recording date alone is not represented as an independently verified first-publication date.
